name: Entu Colony Precog (CR 1/2)
body:
ENTU COLONY PRECOG
CR 1/2

XP 200
Entu colony precog 1
N Small ooze
Init +6; Senses emotionsense 30 ft.; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+1 size, +2 Dex, +2 armor)
hp 10 (1d8+1+1)
Fort +1, Ref +4, Will +1; +2 vs. illusions, paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep, and stunning effects (unless effective against oozes)
Defensive Abilities amorphous, limited ooze benefits

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee dagger –1 (1d3–1 P or S, 19–20/×2)
Ranged light crossbow +2 (1d6 P, 19–20/×2, range incr. 80 ft. AP 1 CW)
Spells Known (CL 1st, concentration +4)

0-level (at will)—bleed, detect magic, mage hand, touch of fatigue
1st-level (2/day)—burning hands (DC 14), disguise self

STATISTICS

Str 8 (–1); Dex 15 (+2); Con 13 (+1); Int 16 (+3); Wis 12 (+1); Cha 10 (+0)
Base Atk +0; CMB –2; CMD 10
Feats Improved Initiative
Skills Acrobatics +6, Diplomacy +4, Knowledge (arcana, local) +7, Knowledge (nature) +4, Linguistics +6, Perception +5, Sense Motive +5, Survival +2
Languages Common, 4 others; limited telepathy 30 ft.
SQ amorphous, anchor (doomed future), focal paradox (Fort saves), paradox (2/day), tactical symbiosis GS6

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Amorphous (Ex)

An entu colony is malleable and shapeless. It is able to create arm-like appendages at will, but can only use two such appendages in any round. An entu colony is immune to precision damage (like sneak attack) and damage from critical hits (but not other effects from critical hits, if applicable).

Emotionsense (Ex)

An entu colony has blindsense with a range of 30 feet. It can only pinpoint creatures with emotions.

Creatures without emotions, including those immune to morale effects and those under the influence of a calm emotions spell or similar effect, cannot be detected by this ability.

Limited Ooze Benefits (Ex)

Unlike most oozes, an entu colony is neither blind nor mindless, but it also lacks the usual ooze immunities. It gains a +2 species bonus on saving throws against illusions, paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep, and stunning effects, unless the effect specifies that it’s effective against oozes. (2)

Limited Telepathy (Su)

A creature with this ability is able to mentally communicate with any creature within 30 feet with whom it shares a language. Otherwise, this ability is identical to the telepathy universal monster ability.

Tactical Symbiosis (Ex)

Once per day as a standard action, an entu colony can temporarily merge a portion of itself with a willing non-entu colony creature it’s telepathically communicated with and can touch. This symbiosis lasts until the beginning of the colony’s next turn. During this time, the colony can’t take any actions but can use each of the following abilities once. A creature can benefit from only one tactical symbiosis at a time.

Cellular Restoration: Restore a number of hit points to the host equal to twice the entu colony’s character level.
Improve Condition: Grant the host an additional save against an ongoing affliction with a +2 circumstance bonus.
Synaptic Pulse: Grant the host a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves until the entu colony’s next turn.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or growth (3–20)
Treasure NPC gear (Small leather armor, Small light crossbow with 10 bolts, Small dagger, other treasure)

Entu are intelligent, mobile colonies of fungal spores. Linked together by complex networks of mycelia, these colonies learn to mimic the different biological systems of intelligent creatures, giving them sensory perception, conscious thought, and responsive mobility. While an entu colony may initially look like a wet blob of slime, a closer look reveals that it in fact has a rubbery texture and contains a number of pseudopod-like limbs, sensory organs, and body cavities.

Entu think of themselves as collectives, and struggle with the concept of individuality.

They’re able to sense the emotions of those around them, and can connect physically with any creature that has emotions.

Occasionally, colonies will form permanent symbiotic relationships with animals, creating an entirely new, composite species.

This is a significant event and not one the entu undertake lightly. It usually happens when bot the entu and the species they bond with face environmental threats for which symbiosis would provide an evolutionary advantage. The animal host undergoes a significant transformation, becoming “awakened” thanks to the influence of its fungal symbiote. Physical changes also usually accompany this transformation, such as a more upright posture and fully articulated hands.
